abilities.name: Weapon Art: Wrath of Stendarr

abilities.name: Whispering Death
abilities.text: Meld into the shadows, doubling sneak effectiveness and sneak attack damage for 30 seconds.

abilities.name: Wind Weapon
abilities.text: The caster's non-enchanted weapons are magically enhanced, attacking 15% faster for 30 seconds.

abilities.name: Windmill Attack
abilities.text: For 20 seconds, power attack wildly with your equipped one-handed weapons.

abilities.name: Worship
abilities.text: When out of combat, pray at a shrine to strengthen your bond with your deity.

abilities.name: You Saw Nothing
abilities.text: Distract the target and others in a 40 foot radius around the target. For 45 seconds, you will not receive a bounty if they are the only witnesses of your crimes.

shouts.name: Aura Whisper
shouts.text: Your Voice is not a Shout, but a whisper, revealing the life forces of any and all.

shouts.name: Battle Fury
shouts.text: Your Thu'um enchants your nearby allies' weapons, allowing them to attack faster.

shouts.name: Become Ethereal
shouts.text: Your Thu'um reaches out to the Void, changing your form to one that cannot harm, or be harmed.

shouts.name: Bend Will
shouts.text: Your Voice bends the very stones to your will. As it gains power, animals, people and even dragons must do your bidding.

shouts.name: Call Dragon
shouts.text: Odahviing! Hear my Voice and come forth. I summon you in my time of need.

shouts.name: Call of Valor
shouts.text: The valiant of Sovngarde hear your Voice, and journey beyond space and time to lend aid.

shouts.name: Clear Skies
shouts.text: Skyrim itself yields before the Thu'um, as you clear away fog and inclement weather.

shouts.name: Cyclone
shouts.text: Your Thu'um creates a whirling cyclone that sows chaos among your enemies.

shouts.name: Disarm
shouts.text: Your Thu'um defies steel, as you rip the weapon from an opponent's grasp.

shouts.name: Dismay
shouts.text: And the weak shall fear the Thu'um, and flee in terror.

shouts.name: Dragon Aspect
shouts.text: Once a day, take on the mighty aspect of a dragon, delivering colossal blows, with an armored hide, and more powerful shouts.

shouts.name: Dragonrend
shouts.text: Your Voice lashes out at a dragon's very soul, forcing the beast to land.

shouts.name: Drain Vitality
shouts.text: Your Thu'um reaches out and steals the very lifeforce of your enemies.

shouts.name: Elemental Fury
shouts.text: The Thu'um imbues you with the power of the elements, enhancing melee attacks.

shouts.name: Fire Breath
shouts.text: Inhale air, exhale flame, and behold the Thu'um as a blazing inferno.

shouts.name: Frost Breath
shouts.text: Your breath is winter, your Thu'um a blizzard.

shouts.name: Ice Form
shouts.text: Your Thu'um is ice, and so are those unfortunate ones who tease your wrath.

shouts.name: Kyne's Peace
shouts.text: Your Thu'um calls forth the grace of Mother Kyne herself, calming animals and filling your body with strength...

shouts.name: Marked for Death
shouts.text: Speak, and let your Voice herald doom, as an opponent's armor and lifeforce wither in a trice.

shouts.name: Miasmic Breath
shouts.text: Your voice is death, behold as your opponents decay.

shouts.name: Phantom Form
shouts.text: Conjures a spectral facade to act as a decoy.

shouts.name: Plague Breath
shouts.text: Your breath is toxic, you Thu'um a plague.

shouts.name: Predator's Might
shouts.text: Your Thu'um commands nature itself to come to your aid and fills your heart with the power of a dire predator.

shouts.name: Slow Time
shouts.text: Shout at time, and command it to obey, as the world around you stands still.

shouts.name: Soul Tear
shouts.text: Your Thu'um cuts through flesh and shatters soul, commanding the will of the fallen.

shouts.name: Static Roar
shouts.text: Your Thu'um projects into a powerful surge of electricity that lingers on damaged foes.

shouts.name: Storm Call
shouts.text: A Shout to the skies, a cry to the clouds, that awakens the destructive force of Skyrim's lightning.

shouts.name: Summon Durnehviir
shouts.text: Durnehviir! Hear my Voice and come forth from the Soul Cairn. I summon you in my time of need.

shouts.name: Throw Voice
shouts.text: The Thu'um is heard, but its source unknown, fooling those into seeking it out.

shouts.name: Unrelenting Force
shouts.text: Your Voice is raw power, pushing aside anything - or anyone - who stands in your path.

shouts.name: Whirlwind Sprint
shouts.text: The Thu'um rushes forward, carrying you in its wake with the speed of a tempest.

passives.name: Weakness to Elements
passives.text: High elves are more resistant to all elements. Fire, frost, and shock deal 10% less damage to you.

passives.name: Highborn
passives.text: High elf blood grants great affinity to magicka. Magicka regenerates 50% faster, spells are 5% more powerful and last longer.

passives.name: Waterbreathing
passives.text: Your Argonian lungs can breathe underwater, while you also find it much easier to swim than members of other races. You can breathe underwater, swimming is 20% faster, swimming is 75% less exhausting.

passives.name: Claws
passives.text: Bestial claws are extremely sharp - sharp enough to easily shred through flesh, making them much more lethal than normal hands. Unarmed damage is increased by 10.

passives.name: Histskin
passives.text: Argonians can nautrally regenerate health faster than others, and their metabolism increases the effect of alchemical substances. Regenerate 1.5 health per second, potions are 10% more effective and last longer.

passives.name: Resist Poison and Disease
passives.text: Your Argonian blood greatly reduces the effect of poison and disease. Poison deals 75% less damage to you, you are 75% less likely to contract diseases.

passives.name: Strong Stomach
passives.text: Your metabolism can digest raw food without food poisoning.

passives.name: Magic Resistance

passives.name: Resist Fire

passives.name: Ashlander

passives.name: Voice of the Emperor

passives.name: Imperial Diversity
passives.text: Imperial education involves various martial and academical trainings, producing citizens with variety of skills. Health, magicka, and stamina regenerate 25% faster.

passives.name: Claws
passives.text: Bestial claws are extremely sharp - sharp enough to easily shred through flesh, making them much more lethal than normal hands. Unarmed damage is increased by 10.

passives.name: Feline Agility

passives.name: Strong Stomach

passives.name: Fingersmith
passives.text: Khajiits have keen senses and dexterity, making them much more proficient in thievery. Lockpicking expertise is increased by 2, lockpicks are 20% more durable, pickpocketing is 20% more likely to succeed, you are 20% harder to detect.

passives.name: Resist Frost and Shock
passives.text: Your Nord blood halves all taken frost damage. Frost deals 50% less damage.

passives.name: Ancient Tongues
passives.text: Nords have inherent ability to Shout, and can unleash immense power through the Voice. Shouts are 10% more powerful and last longer, Shouts can be used 10% more often.

passives.name: Barbaric Strength
passives.text: Nords are fierce and strong, skilled with all melee weapons. Melee weapons deal 5% more damage.

passives.name: Bulwark
passives.text: Orcs have incredible strength and endurance, resistant to all types of damage. Armor rating increases by 150, magic deals 10% less damage to you.

passives.name: Strong Stomach
passives.text: Your metabolism can digest raw food without food poisoning.

passives.name: Resist Poison and Disease
passives.text: Your Redguard blood, tempered in the deserts of Hammerfell, grants you a very strong resistance to poisons and diseases. Poison deals 50% less damage to you, you are 50% less likely to contract diseases.

passives.name: Adrenaline Rush
passives.text: Redguards are granted increased stamina, and can sprint much longer without being exhausted. Stamina regenerations is increased, sprinting costs 1 less stamina per second.

passives.name: Martial Prowess
passives.text: Redguards are naturally skilled in martial arts, and can wield their weapons with great precision. Armor penetration with melee weapons is increased by 5.
